verification.grade_check_policy: Every S0/FU string tested for hold numbers, contextual strength, compound strength stems, flexibility and finish grades. Claims raw grades are authorized evidence under R2-Q3 and must remain unchanged; every claims string still tested for forbidden annotations, round/filter/editorial labels, slugs, old ids and route labels.
